notes.title: A Change to Pausing
notes.content:
[list]
[*] When pausing, most actions are now disabled. 
[*] Fixed a UI bug if the quota got too high
[/list]

notes.title: Overdue Research Bug Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed the Carrier upkeep research so that it now does actually reduce Carrier upkeep by 25%
[/list]

notes.title: August 23 - Tooltips
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added tooltips that appear after hovering buttons for more than a second. Hopefully this makes the functionality clearer.
[*] Modified UI so misclicking near a button won't sent the Excavator way off course.
[/list]

notes.title: August 15 Patch - Bug + Exploit Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reworked the loading screen mechanism so it won't hang.
[*] Fixed a minor exploit that was discovered.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes August 13th - Minor but annoying
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix a UI bug where lookouts could not be moved on the minimap if their icon overlapped the Excavators icon.
[*] Improve the Syndicate loss Explanation.
[/list]
